remarks: Welcome to this stunning half-duplex in the growing community of Mattson! Designed with modern living in mind, this beautiful home features a convenient separate side entrance and a bright, open-concept main floor. The stylish kitchen showcases light wood cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops, and a calming, contemporary design. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly together—perfect for family time and effortless entertaining. Upstairs, you’ll find a versatile flex space, convenient laundry, a full bathroom, and three spacious bedrooms. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a modern private ensuite. An appliance package, front landscaping, and rear landscaping are all included, making this home truly move-in ready. Photos are from a previous build and may not be an exact representation of the completed home. Interior colour selections are represented; finishes and upgrades may vary. (id:67522)
